permutation_definition: Sample the same number of nodes from all measured input nodes; preserve global author-selected graph. Report all factors including empty and single-parent networks.
author_P_values: psych default adjusted upper triangle followed by author BH; raw Pearson/BH separate diagnostics
rank_rule: rho[k-2]<rho[k-1]<rho[k]>rho[k+1]; maximize admissible rho; smaller k only for exact ties
